WITH engagement_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`, UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
),
engagement_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`, UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM engagement_7day e7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM engagement_2day e2 WHERE e2.user_pseudo_id = e7.user_pseudo_id
)

-- Final verification: show the top product with full details
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
qualifying_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
    AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM qualifying_hits
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitStartTime,
    device.isMobile AS is_mobile,
    SUM(CASE WHEN hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hit_txn_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS hit
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, date, visitStartTime, device.isMobile
),
user_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date,
    MAX(date) AS last_visit_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN hit_txn_count > 0 THEN date END) AS first_txn_date
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
last_visit_dev AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, ANY_VALUE(s.is_mobile) AS last_visit_is_mobile
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN user_agg ua ON s.fullVisitorId = ua.fullVisitorId AND s.date = ua.last_visit_date
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
),
first_txn_dev AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, ANY_VALUE(s.is_mobile) AS first_txn_is_mobile
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN user_agg ua ON s.fullVisitorId = ua.fullVisitorId AND s.date = ua.first_txn_date
  WHERE ua.first_txn_date IS NOT NULL AND s.hit_txn_count > 0
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
)
SELECT ua.fullVisitorId, ua.first_visit_date, ua.last_visit_date, ua.first_txn_date,
  lvd.last_visit_is_mobile, ftd.first_txn_is_mobile
FROM user_agg ua
JOIN last_visit_dev lvd ON ua.fullVisitorId = lvd.fullVisitorId
LEFT JOIN first_txn_dev ftd ON ua.fullVisitorId = ftd.fullVisitorId
LIMIT 10

WITH quinapril_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.drug_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength` ds
  WHERE ds.ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
),
users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
  WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT drug_concept_id FROM quinapril_drugs)
)

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) as total_persons,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) as users_using,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) as not_using,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`)) * 100 as percentage_not_using

-- Get the final coordinates for TEDDY (second longest distance storm)
SELECT latitude, longitude, iso_time, usa_status
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND name = 'TEDDY'
ORDER BY iso_time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    season,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' 
    AND CAST(season AS STRING) = '2020'
    AND track_type = 'main'
    AND name = 'LAURA'
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    a.sid,
    a.name,
    a.season,
    a.iso_time,
    a.latitude,
    a.longitude,
    a.usa_wind,
    a.rn,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(a.longitude, a.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(b.longitude, b.latitude)
    ) / 1000.0 AS segment_km
  FROM storm_tracks a
  LEFT JOIN storm_tracks b 
    ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    season,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    rn,
    segment_km,
    SUM(segment_km) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_distance_km
  FROM distances
)
SELECT 
  name,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  cumulative_distance_km,
  usa_wind
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY rn

WITH daily_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    s.country,
    g.date,
    AVG(g.temp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(g.max) as avg_max,
    AVG(g.min) as avg_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s 
    ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE g.mo = '10' AND g.da BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
    AND g.temp != 9999.9 AND g.max != 9999.9 AND g.min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY s.country, g.date
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_temp END) as us_avg_temp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_max END) as us_avg_max,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_min END) as us_avg_min,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_temp END) as uk_avg_temp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_max END) as uk_avg_max,
    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_min END) as uk_avg_min
  FROM daily_stats
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT
  date,
  ROUND(us_avg_max - uk_avg_max, 1) as diff_max_temp,
  ROUND(us_avg_min - uk_avg_min, 1) as diff_min_temp,
  ROUND(us_avg_temp - uk_avg_temp, 1) as diff_avg_temp
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY date

WITH stations_near_chappaqua AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name, lat, lon
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
    ST_GEOGPOINT(lon, lat),
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197),
    20 * 1609.344
  )
)
SELECT 
  s.name,
  s.usaf,
  s.wban,
  s.lat,
  s.lon,
  COUNT(g.temp) as valid_temp_observations
FROM stations_near_chappaqua s
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` g
  ON s.usaf = g.stn AND s.wban = g.wban
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
  AND g.temp IS NOT NULL
  AND g.temp != 9999.9
GROUP BY s.name, s.usaf, s.wban, s.lat, s.lon
ORDER BY s.name

WITH weather AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    AVG(temp) AS avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY year, mo, da
),
complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) AS date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
total_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) AS date,
    COUNT(*) AS total_daily
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    w.date,
    w.avg_temp,
    c.complaint_type,
    c.daily_count,
    t.total_daily,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.daily_count, t.total_daily) AS daily_pct
  FROM weather w
  INNER JOIN complaints c ON w.date = c.date
  INNER JOIN total_complaints t ON w.date = t.date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(avg_temp) AS sum_temp,
    SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) AS sum_temp_sq,
    SUM(daily_count) AS sum_count,
    SUM(daily_count * daily_count) AS sum_count_sq,
    SUM(avg_temp * daily_count) AS sum_temp_count,
    SUM(daily_pct) AS sum_pct,
    SUM(daily_pct * daily_pct) AS sum_pct_sq,
    SUM(avg_temp * daily_pct) AS sum_temp_pct
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000
),
total_complaints_per_type AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(daily_count) AS total_complaints_val
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000
),
corr AS (
  SELECT 
    s.complaint_type,
    tc.total_complaints_val,
    s.n,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      s.n * s.sum_temp_count - s.sum_temp * s.sum_count,
      SQRT((s.n * s.sum_temp_sq - s.sum_temp * s.sum_temp) * (s.n * s.sum_count_sq - s.sum_count * s.sum_count))
    ) AS corr_temp_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      s.n * s.sum_temp_pct - s.sum_temp * s.sum_pct,
      SQRT((s.n * s.sum_temp_sq - s.sum_temp * s.sum_temp) * (s.n * s.sum_pct_sq - s.sum_pct * s.sum_pct))
    ) AS corr_temp_pct
  FROM stats s
  JOIN total_complaints_per_type tc ON s.complaint_type = tc.complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_complaints_val AS total_complaints,
  n AS days_with_valid_temperature,
  ROUND(corr_temp_count, 4) AS corr_temp_daily_count,
  ROUND(corr_temp_pct, 4) AS corr_temp_daily_pct
FROM corr
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(corr_temp_count) DESC

WITH y1995_counts AS (
  SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as latin, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good','Excellent','Poor','Fair','Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive_1995,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead_1995,
    COUNT(*) as total_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
y2015_counts AS (
  SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as latin,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead_2015,
    COUNT(*) as total_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
c1995_common AS (
  SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as latin, spc_common, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
),
top1995 AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM c1995_common
),
c2015_common AS (
  SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as latin, spc_common, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
),
top2015 AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM c2015_common
),
species_common AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) as latin,
    COALESCE(ts.species_common_name, top1995.spc_common, top2015.spc_common) as common_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts
  LEFT JOIN top1995 ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = top1995.latin AND top1995.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN top2015 ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = top2015.latin AND top2015.rn = 1
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    y1995_counts.latin,
    COALESCE(species_common.common_name, top1995.spc_common, top2015.spc_common) as common_name,
    y1995_counts.total_1995,
    y2015_counts.total_2015,
    y1995_counts.alive_1995,
    y2015_counts.alive_2015,
    y1995_counts.dead_1995,
    y2015_counts.dead_2015,
    y2015_counts.total_2015 - y1995_counts.total_1995 as growth_total,
    y2015_counts.alive_2015 - y1995_counts.alive_1995 as growth_alive,
    y2015_counts.dead_2015 - y1995_counts.dead_1995 as growth_dead
  FROM y1995_counts
  JOIN y2015_counts ON y1995_counts.latin = y2015_counts.latin
  LEFT JOIN species_common ON y1995_counts.latin = species_common.latin
  LEFT JOIN top1995 ON y1995_counts.latin = top1995.latin AND top1995.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN top2015 ON y1995_counts.latin = top2015.latin AND top2015.rn = 1
)
SELECT latin, common_name, total_1995, total_2015, alive_1995, alive_2015, dead_1995, dead_2015, growth_total, growth_alive, growth_dead
FROM joined
ORDER BY growth_total DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH trip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tz.borough AS pickup_borough,
    CASE
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 5 THEN 'up to 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 5 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 10 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 15 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 20 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      ELSE 'more than 25%'
    END AS tip_category,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE
    t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01')
    AND t.pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP('2016-01-08')
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
  GROUP BY tz.borough, tip_category
)
SELECT
  pickup_borough,
  tip_category,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_count, SUM(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_borough)) AS proportion
FROM trip_counts
ORDER BY pickup_borough, tip_category

WITH clay AS (
  SELECT trip_id, stop_sequence AS clay_seq, departure_time AS clay_departure
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times`
  WHERE stop_id = 14015
),
sacramento AS (
  SELECT trip_id, stop_sequence AS sacramento_seq, arrival_time AS sacramento_arrival
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times`
  WHERE stop_id = 16294
)
SELECT tr.trip_headsign, tr.route_id,
       MIN(c.clay_departure) AS earliest_departure,
       MAX(s.sacramento_arrival) AS latest_arrival
FROM clay c
JOIN sacramento s ON c.trip_id = s.trip_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` tr ON CAST(c.trip_id AS STRING) = tr.trip_id
WHERE c.clay_seq < s.sacramento_seq
GROUP BY tr.trip_headsign, tr.route_id
ORDER BY tr.trip_headsign

-- Final query: percentage of each country's population confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020
SELECT 
  c.country_name,
  c.cumulative_confirmed,
  w.year_2018 as population_2018,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cumulative_confirmed, w.year_2018) * 100, 4) as percentage_confirmed
FROM (
  SELECT country_name, country_code, cumulative_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE date = DATE('2020-06-30')
  AND aggregation_level = 0
  AND country_code IS NOT NULL
) c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` w
ON c.country_name = w.country
WHERE w.country NOT IN ('Lower middle income', 'Low income', 'High income', 'Upper middle income', 'Not classified', 'Arab World', 'East Asia & Pacific', 'Europe & Central Asia', 'Latin America & Caribbean', 'North America', 'South Asia', 'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'OECD members', 'Euro area', 'World')
AND w.year_2018 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY percentage_confirmed DESC

WITH daily_new_cases AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    county,
    state_name,
    confirmed_cases,
    confirmed_cases - LAG(confirmed_cases) OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY date) AS new_cases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_nyt.us_counties`
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-05-31'
    AND state_name = 'Illinois'
),
daily_top5 AS (
  SELECT date, county, state_name, new_cases,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY new_cases DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_new_cases
  WHERE new_cases IS NOT NULL AND new_cases > 0
),
county_freq AS (
  SELECT county, COUNT(*) as top5_frequency
  FROM daily_top5
  WHERE rn <= 5
  GROUP BY county
)
SELECT county, top5_frequency
FROM county_freq
ORDER BY top5_frequency DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH target_zips AS (
    SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
    WHERE ST_DISTANCE(internal_point_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833)) < 5 * 1609.344
),
tract_zip_alloc AS (
    SELECT 
        t.geo_id,
        z.zip_code,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)),
            ST_AREA(t.tract_geom)
        ) as allocation_ratio,
        a.total_pop,
        a.income_per_capita
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` a
        ON t.geo_id = a.geo_id
    JOIN target_zips z
        ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
    WHERE a.total_pop > 0
)
SELECT 
    zip_code,
    ROUND(SUM(total_pop * allocation_ratio), 0) as total_population,
    ROUND(SUM(total_pop * allocation_ratio * income_per_capita) / NULLIF(SUM(total_pop * allocation_ratio), 0), 1) as avg_individual_income
FROM tract_zip_alloc
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH top_venues AS (
  SELECT 
    'Top Venues' AS category,
    'N/A' AS date,
    venue_name AS matchup,
    venue_capacity AS key_metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams`
  WHERE venue_capacity IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY venue_capacity DESC) <= 5
),
biggest_championship_margins AS (
  SELECT 
    'Biggest Championship Margins' AS category,
    CAST(game_date AS STRING) AS date,
    CONCAT(win_market, ' vs ', lose_market) AS matchup,
    win_pts - lose_pts AS key_metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE round = 2 AND season > 2015

-- Final query with proper formatting for avg_fare to always show 2 decimal places
WITH distinct_minutes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) as duration_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL AND CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
),
minute_groups AS (
  SELECT duration_minutes, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY duration_minutes) as quantile_group
  FROM distinct_minutes
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(MIN(mg.duration_minutes) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ', LPAD(CAST(MAX(mg.duration_minutes) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm') as time_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_trips,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(t.fare), SUM(CASE WHEN t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)), 2) as avg_fare
FROM minute_groups mg
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` t
  ON CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) = mg.duration_minutes
  AND t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
GROUP BY mg.quantile_group
ORDER BY MIN(mg.duration_minutes)

WITH region_variants AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as variant_count,
    SUM(AN) as total_AN
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1'
    AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
    AND end_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
    AND ARRAY_LENGTH(alternate_bases) > 0
),
total_ac AS (
  SELECT SUM(AB.AC) as total_AC
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`,
  UNNEST(alternate_bases) AS AB
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1'
    AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
    AND end_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
    AND ARRAY_LENGTH(alternate_bases) > 0
),
distinct_genes AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT V.SYMBOL) as distinct_genes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`,
  UNNEST(alternate_bases) AS AB,
  UNNEST(AB.vep) AS V
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1'
    AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
    AND end_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
    AND ARRAY_LENGTH(alternate_bases) > 0
    AND V.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  rv.variant_count,
  total_ac.total_AC as total_allele_count,
  rv.total_AN as total_number_of_alleles,
  dg.distinct_genes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(55064852 - 55039447, rv.variant_count) as mutation_density
FROM region_variants rv, total_ac, distinct_genes dg

SELECT 
  a.consecutive_number,
  a.county,
  a.type_of_intersection,
  a.light_condition,
  a.atmospheric_conditions_1,
  a.hour_of_crash,
  a.functional_system,
  a.related_factors_crash_level_1 AS related_factors,
  CASE WHEN a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital BETWEEN 0 AND 23 
    THEN a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital - a.hour_of_crash 
    ELSE NULL END AS delay_to_hospital,
  CASE WHEN a.hour_of_arrival_at_scene BETWEEN 0 AND 23 
    THEN a.hour_of_arrival_at_scene - a.hour_of_crash 
    ELSE NULL END AS delay_to_scene,
  p.age,
  p.person_type,
  p.seating_position,
  CASE 
    WHEN p.restraint_system_helmet_use = 0 THEN 0
    WHEN p.restraint_system_helmet_use = 1 THEN 0.33
    WHEN p.restraint_system_helmet_use = 2 THEN 0.67
    WHEN p.restraint_system_helmet_use = 3 THEN 1.0
    ELSE 0.5
  END AS restraint,
  CASE WHEN p.injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS survived,
  CASE WHEN v.rollover LIKE 'Rollover%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rollover,
  CASE WHEN p.air_bag_deployed BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS airbag,
  CASE WHEN p.police_reported_alcohol_involvement LIKE '%Yes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS alcohol,
  CASE WHEN p.police_reported_drug_involvement LIKE '%Yes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS drugs,
  p.related_factors_person_level1,
  v.travel_speed,
  CASE WHEN v.speeding_related LIKE '%Yes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS speeding_related,
  v.extent_of_damage,
  v.body_type,
  v.vehicle_removal,
  LEAST(a.manner_of_collision, 11) AS manner_of_collision,
  CASE WHEN v.roadway_surface_condition > 11 THEN 8 ELSE v.roadway_surface_condition END AS roadway_surface_condition,
  CASE WHEN a.first_harmful_event >= 90 THEN 0 ELSE a.first_harmful_event END AS first_harmful_event,
  CASE WHEN v.most_harmful_event >= 90 THEN 0 ELSE v.most_harmful_event END AS most_harmful_event
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p
  ON a.consecutive_number = p.consecutive_number
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2015` v
  ON a.consecutive_number = v.consecutive_number AND p.vehicle_number = v.vehicle_number
LIMIT 12

WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(CoC_Number, 1, 2) as state_abbr,
    Count_Year,
    SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year IN (2015, 2018)
  GROUP BY state_abbr, Count_Year
),
state_pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    state_abbr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2015 THEN total_unsheltered ELSE 0 END) as cnt_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2018 THEN total_unsheltered ELSE 0 END) as cnt_2018
  FROM state_counts
  GROUP BY state_abbr
),
state_pct_change AS (
  SELECT 
    state_abbr,
    cnt_2015,
    cnt_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(cnt_2018 - cnt_2015, cnt_2015) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM state_pivoted
  WHERE cnt_2015 > 0
),
avg_change AS (
  SELECT AVG(pct_change) as national_avg
  FROM state_pct_change
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT s.state_abbr, s.pct_change, a.national_avg, ABS(s.pct_change - a.national_avg) as abs_diff,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(s.pct_change - a.national_avg), s.state_abbr) as rn
  FROM state_pct_change s, avg_change a
)
SELECT state_abbr, pct_change, national_avg, abs_diff, rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY abs_diff, state_abbr

WITH user_range AS (
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE id BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208
),
-- Questions authored by these users in the date range
questions_contrib AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.tags AS question_tags,
    pq.creation_date AS contribution_date,
    'question' AS contribution_type,
    pq.id AS post_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq
  JOIN user_range ur ON pq.owner_user_id = ur.id
  WHERE pq.creation_date >= '2019-07-01' 
    AND pq.creation_date < '2020-01-01'
),
-- Answers posted by these users in the date range
answers_contrib AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.tags AS question_tags,
    pa.creation_date AS contribution_date,
    'answer' AS contribution_type,
    pa.id AS post_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN user_range ur ON pa.owner_user_id = ur.id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE pa.creation_date >= '2019-07-01' 
    AND pa.creation_date < '2020-01-01'
),
-- Comments on questions by these users in the date range
comments_on_questions AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_id AS user_id,
    pq.tags AS question_tags,
    c.creation_date AS contribution_date,
    'comment_on_question' AS contribution_type,
    c.id AS post_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.comments` c
  JOIN user_range ur ON c.user_id = ur.id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON c.post_id = pq.id
  WHERE c.creation_date >= '2019-07-01' 
    AND c.creation_date < '2020-01-01'
),
-- Comments on answers by these users in the date range
comments_on_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_id AS user_id,
    pq.tags AS question_tags,
    c.creation_date AS contribution_date,
    'comment_on_answer' AS contribution_type,
    c.id AS post_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.comments` c
  JOIN user_range ur ON c.user_id = ur.id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa ON c.post_id = pa.id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE c.creation_date >= '2019-07-01' 
    AND c.creation_date < '2020-01-01'
)
SELECT user_id, question_tags
FROM questions_contrib
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, question_tags
FROM answers_contrib
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, question_tags
FROM comments_on_questions
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, question_tags
FROM comments_on_answers
ORDER BY user_id, question_tags

WITH qualifying_questions AS (
  -- Questions with accepted answer
  SELECT q.id, q.body, q.owner_user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  -- Questions without accepted answer but with at least one answer having score/view > 0.01
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id, q.body, q.owner_user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL
    AND q.view_count > 0
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(a.score, q.view_count) > 0.01
),
user_badges AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as badge_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT 
  qq.id as question_id,
  LENGTH(qq.body) as body_length,
  u.reputation,
  u.up_votes - u.down_votes as net_votes,
  COALESCE(ub.badge_count, 0) as badge_count
FROM qualifying_questions qq
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON qq.owner_user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN user_badges ub ON qq.owner_user_id = ub.user_id
ORDER BY body_length DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD'
),
kras_mut AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
tp53_mut AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
both_mut AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k.ParticipantBarcode) as cnt
  FROM kras_mut k
  INNER JOIN tp53_mut t ON k.ParticipantBarcode = t.ParticipantBarcode
),
no_mut AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ParticipantBarcode) as cnt
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN kras_mut k ON p.ParticipantBarcode = k.ParticipantBarcode
  LEFT JOIN tp53_mut t ON p.ParticipantBarcode = t.ParticipantBarcode
  WHERE k.ParticipantBarcode IS NULL AND t.ParticipantBarcode IS NULL
)
SELECT (SELECT cnt FROM both_mut) - (SELECT cnt FROM no_mut) as net_difference

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` zc 
    ON LEFT(i.zip_code, 5) = zc.zip_code
  WHERE i.state = 'NY'
  GROUP BY zc.census_tract_geoid
) c ON ct.geo_id = c.census_tract_geoid
GROUP BY ct.geo_id, ct.median_income
ORDER BY ct.geo_id

WITH small_contribs AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.cmte_id,
    cc.transaction_amt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_contributions_2016` cc
  WHERE cc.entity_tp = 'IND' 
    AND cc.transaction_amt > 0 
    AND cc.transaction_amt < 200
),
committees_with_small_contribs AS (
  SELECT 
    cmte_id,
    SUM(transaction_amt) as total_small_contributions
  FROM small_contribs
  GROUP BY cmte_id
  HAVING SUM(transaction_amt) > 0
),
candidate_support AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    cmte_id,
    cand_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_committee_2016`
)
SELECT 
  c.cmte_nm,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cand_id) as num_candidates,
  STRING_AGG(cand2016.cand_name, ',' ORDER BY cand2016.cand_name) as candidate_names,
  cwc.total_small_contributions
FROM committees_with_small_contribs cwc
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_2016` c ON c.cmte_id = cwc.cmte_id
JOIN candidate_support cs ON cs.cmte_id = cwc.cmte_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_2016` cand2016 ON cand2016.cand_id = cs.cand_id
GROUP BY c.cmte_nm, cwc.cmte_id, cwc.total_small_contributions
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cand_id) >= 1
ORDER BY total_small_contributions DESC

-- Final query: ZIP code with highest concentration (average distributed banks per overlapping block group)
WITH 
bank_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(*) as bank_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
zip_bg_overlaps AS (
  SELECT 
    zg.zip_code,
    bg.geo_id,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(zg.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)) / ST_AREA(bg.blockgroup_geom) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` zg
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` bg
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(zg.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE zg.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND bg.state_fips_code = '08'
)
SELECT 
  zg.zip_code,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(zg.overlap_ratio * bc.bank_count), COUNT(*)) as avg_concentration
FROM zip_bg_overlaps zg
JOIN bank_counts bc ON zg.zip_code = bc.zip_code
GROUP BY zg.zip_code
ORDER BY avg_concentration DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'cat' THEN url_count ELSE 0 END) as cat_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'other' THEN url_count ELSE 0 END) as other_count
FROM (
  SELECT 'cat' as category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.original_url) as url_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels` l
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i ON l.image_id = i.image_id
  WHERE l.label_name = '/m/01yrx' AND l.confidence = 1.0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'other' as category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.original_url) as url_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i
  WHERE i.image_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT image_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels` WHERE label_name = '/m/01yrx'
  )
)

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS distinct_users
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
UNNEST(event_params) AS page_params
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210131'
  AND event_name = 'page_view'
  AND page_params.key = 'page_location'
  AND page_params.value.string_value = 'https://shop.googlemerchandisestore.com/'

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    rn,
    user_pseudo_id,
    CASE
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 6
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)], r'\+')
        AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)')
          OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)'))
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 6
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)], r'\+')
        AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)')
          OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)'))
      THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE page_title
    END AS display_title
  FROM page_views
),
with_flag AS (
  SELECT
    rn,
    user_pseudo_id,
    display_title,
    CASE WHEN rn = 1 OR display_title != LAG(display_title) OVER (ORDER BY rn) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new
  FROM classified
)
SELECT
  user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>' ORDER BY rn) AS navigation_flow
FROM with_flag
WHERE is_new = 1
GROUP BY user_pseudo_id

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    DISTINCT (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id,
    COALESCE(traffic_source.medium, '') AS medium,
    COALESCE(traffic_source.source, '') AS source,
    COALESCE(traffic_source.name, '') AS name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  AND (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') IS NOT NULL
),
channelized AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo','facebook','fb','instagram','linkedin','pinterest','tiktok','twitter','whatsapp') 
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch') 
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')) 
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display','banner','expandable','interstitial','cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN name LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo','facebook','fb','instagram','linkedin','pinterest','tiktok','twitter','whatsapp')) 
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social','social-network','social-media','sm','social network','social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch')) 
           OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')) 
           OR name LIKE '%shop%' OR name LIKE '%shopping%' THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) as session_count
FROM channelized
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY session_count DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Final retention analysis for new users
WITH user_first AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_touch AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    user_first_touch_timestamp
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, user_first_touch_timestamp
),
new_users AS (
  SELECT 
    uf.user_pseudo_id,
    uf.first_session_date
  FROM user_first uf
  JOIN user_touch ut ON uf.user_pseudo_id = ut.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(ut.user_first_touch_timestamp))) = uf.first_session_date
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date)) - 2) DAY) as cohort_start
  FROM new_users
  WHERE DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date)) - 2) DAY) 
    BETWEEN '2018-07-09' AND '2018-09-17'
),
user_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', uc.cohort_start) as cohort_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id) as total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
    WHEN us.event_date = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(CAST(uc.cohort_start AS DATE), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
    THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
  END) as retained_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN us.event_date = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(CAST(uc.cohort_start AS DATE), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
      THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
    END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id)
  ), 4) as retention_rate
FROM user_cohort uc
LEFT JOIN user_sessions us ON uc.user_pseudo_id = us.user_pseudo_id
GROUP BY uc.cohort_start
ORDER BY uc.cohort_start

WITH first_opens AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) as first_open_timestamp
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20180930'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_open_timestamp
  FROM first_opens
  WHERE TIMESTAMP_MICROS(first_open_timestamp + 28800000000) >= '2018-09-01'
    AND TIMESTAMP_MICROS(first_open_timestamp + 28800000000) < '2018-09-08'
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    e.event_timestamp,
    DATE_DIFF(
      DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp + 28800000000)),
      DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(c.first_open_timestamp + 28800000000)),
      DAY
    ) as days_since_first_open
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181015'
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN days_since_first_open BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week1_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN days_since_first_open BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week2_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN days_since_first_open BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week3_retained
  FROM user_events
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week1_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week2_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week3_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM retention
